title: Hyperbolic Poincaré disk
blurb: Eight live HTML cards placed on a Poincaré disk with a {7, 4} geodesic tiling. Drag to apply Möbius isometries, press Tab to glide the focused card to the centre, and toggle the linear Jacobian hit-box overlay.
question: Can live interactive HTML cards sit inside a non-Euclidean Poincaré disk, glide under real-time Möbius drag transforms and Tab focus changes, and stay clickable via local-Jacobian conformal updateElementGeometry() approximations?
result: Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context drawing a {7, 4} hyperbolic geodesic tiling, eight live drawable cards mapped through exact inverse Möbius transforms in GLSL, local-Jacobian DOMMatrix hit boxes with dataset.hitTick cache clearing, and a tangent hit-box overlay. Live browser verification is not run yet.
